Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_file_temp text_io.file_type; 
 vfile_name varchar2(100);
 v_string varchar2(500);
 command VARCHAR2(100);
 dos_cmd VARCHAR2(100);
 m_workarea VARCHAR2(512);
 sep VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := WebUtil_Core.getServerFileSep;
 file_ext VARCHAR2(100) := '*.dmp.gz';
 dmp_ext VARCHAR2(30);
 temp_filename VARCHAR2(100);
 v_output_str VARCHAR2(200);
 l_success BOOLEAN;
 v_status VARCHAR2(1) := 'S';
 l_temp_text VARCHAR2(100);
 server_fname VARCHAR2(400);
 client_dir VARCHAR2(400); --D:\lifetrak\replication; code 'MPCDD' Code Type : APIDR
 alert_id NUMBER;
 l_status VARCHAR2(1000);
 TYPE FILE_LIST is TABLE of VARCHAR2(1000) index by PLS_INTEGER;
 l_file_list file_list;
 l_idx PLS_integer;
 al_id ALERT; 
 al_button NUMBER;
 msg VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 -------------
 -- Alert user 
 msg := 'You are going to download the data, this process will overwrite the current data on the local database. Do you want to continue?';
 al_id := Find_Alert('DWNLD_ALERT'); 
 Set_Alert_Property(al_id, alert_message_text, msg ); 
 al_button := Show_Alert( al_id ); 
 
 if al_button = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 null;
 else
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if; 
 ------------
 
 -- Get the download directory location from master code;
 begin
 select description into client_dir from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'APIDR' and code = 'MPCDD' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 display_msg('Master Code MPCDD (Mobile PC Directory for Download from LT Server) not defined');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 display_msg(sqlcode || '-' || substr(sqlerrm,1,75));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 --------------
 
 -- Get the extension parameter for download file
 begin
 SELECT parameter_value INTO dmp_ext
 FROM valid_parameters
 WHERE parameter_code = 'MO_DMP_EXT'
 AND SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE + 1);
 
 file_ext := '*.' || dmp_ext;
 
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 display_msg('System Parameter (MO_DMP_EXT) not defined for download process');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 display_msg(sqlcode || '-' || substr(sqlerrm,1,75));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 --------------
 
 ---------------
 -- Get the list of files to be downloaded. Run the Host Command;
 m_workarea := WebUtil_Core.ReadFromPropertyBundle('transfer.appsrv.workAreaRoot');
 temp_filename := m_workarea || sep || 'list.log';
 command := '/bin/ls ' 
 || m_workarea 
 || sep 
 || file_ext 
 || '>' 
 || temp_filename;
 
 HOST(command);
 --host('/bin/ls /tmp/webutil/*.txt>/tmp/webutil/list.log');
 ---------------
 
 -----------------
 -- Read the file names and store it in plsql table;
 BEGIN 
 v_file_temp := text_io.fopen(temp_filename, 'r'); 
 l_file_list.delete;
 --l_idx := l_file_list.FIRST;
 L_IDX := 0;
 loop 
 text_io.get_line(v_file_temp, v_output_str); 
 vfile_name := SUBSTR(v_output_str, INSTR(v_output_str,sep,-1)+1);
 l_idx := l_idx + 1;
 l_file_list(l_idx) := vfile_name;
 end loop;
 text_io.fclose(v_file_temp);
 EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 text_io.fclose(v_file_temp);
 when others then
 text_io.fclose(v_file_temp); 
 END;
 ------------------
 
 /*
 -----------------------
 -- delete the temporary file from server
 cmd := 'rm ' || temp_filename;
 host(cmd);
 -----------------------
 */
 
 ------------------
 -- Loop through the plsql table to pass each file name to download_as routine;
 for i in 1 .. l_file_list.count
 loop
 server_fname := m_workarea || sep || l_file_list(i);
 l_success := download_as(server_fname, client_dir);
 if l_success then
 null;
 else
 v_status := 'F';
 l_temp_text := l_file_list(i);
 exit;
 end if;
 --l_temp_text := l_temp_text || l_file_list(i) || chr(10);
 end loop;
 
 if v_status = 'F' then
 display_msg('Error downloading file - '|| l_temp_text || '. Downloading Cancelled.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 --client_host('cmd /c rundll32 url.dll,FileProtocolHandler C:\Program Files\Microsoft LifeCam\LifeCam.exe');
 --CLIENT_HOST('cmd /c d:\lifetrak\replication\download.bat');
 dos_cmd := 'cmd /c '
 || client_dir
 || '\download.bat';
 CLIENT_HOST(dos_cmd);
 display_msg(l_file_list.count || ' Files downloaded - successfully.');
 end if;
 ---------------------
EXCEPTION
 when form_trigger_failure then raise;
 
 when others then
 l_status := 'Download Failed ' || sqlcode || '-' || substr(sqlerrm, 100);
 display_msg(l_status); 
 log_error('LTAPI', 'MOBILE PC DOWNLOAD', l_status); 
 raise form_trigger_failure;

END;

 CURSOR str_token_cur (l_string_in IN VARCHAR2, l_sep IN VARCHAR2) IS
 SELECT str_token 
 FROM
 ( SELECT TRIM (SUBSTR (txt,
 INSTR (txt, l_sep, 1, LEVEL) + 1,
 INSTR (txt, l_sep, 1, LEVEL + 1) - INSTR (txt, l_sep, 1, LEVEL) - 1
 )
 ) AS str_token
 FROM (SELECT l_sep || l_string_in || l_sep txt FROM DUAL)
 CONNECT BY LEVEL <= LENGTH (l_string_in) - LENGTH (REPLACE (l_string_in, l_sep, '')) + 1
 );
 
 cntr NUMBER := 0; 
 l_col_name VARCHAR2(100); 
 
 --SCR 11942

 ------------
 -- Get the upload directory location from master code;
 begin
 select description into file_dir from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'APIDR' and code = 'MPCDU' 
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);

 when others then

 --------------

 end if;

 raise upload_fail;
 end if;
 ----------------

 from lt_laptop_staging;

 */

 -- Copy only files extracted from connected laptop.

 BEGIN

 nline := 0;

 l_record := null;

 IF l_record IS NOT NULL THEN

 IF sep_pos = 0 THEN -- string is not in correct format
 l_status := 'Error Reading Line ' || nline || ' of file ' || l_file_list(i)|| ' - ' || '3 spaces Seperator not found. Upload Cancelled';
 RAISE copy_fail;
 ELSE
 l_data_str := substr(l_record, 0, sep_pos-1);
 l_data_flag := substr(l_record, sep_pos+3, 1);
 IF l_data_flag NOT IN ('0', '1') then
 l_status := 'Encrypt flag not found in line ' || nline || ' of file ' || l_file_list(i) || ' - ' || 'Upload Cancelled';
 RAISE copy_fail;
 END IF;
 l_data_string := l_data_str;
 INSERT INTO lt_laptop_staging(data_string, decrypt_flag, insert_date, insert_user)
 VALUES(l_data_string, l_data_flag, SYSDATE, :banner.user_id);
 END IF; -- Sep_pos if condition 
 END IF; -- l_record not null if condition
 END LOOP; -- to read SERVER file;
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN no_data_found THEN
 TEXT_IO.FCLOSE(l_out_file);
 END; 
 --END IF; -- laptopID if condition.
 END IF; -- txt, dat files if condition.
 END LOOP; -- files loop;

 :system.message_level := '10';

 :system.message_level := '0';
 END; 
 
 /*

 IF encimages_list.count > 0 THEN

ProgramUnit.Name: DOWNLOAD_AS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION DOWNLOAD_AS(download_fname IN VARCHAR2, download_dir IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_success BOOLEAN;
 --client_directory VARCHAR2(100) := 'C:\LT_ServerData';
 --client_directory VARCHAR2(100) := 'D:\lifetrak\replication';
 client_fname VARCHAR2(512);
 client_fsep VARCHAR2(1);
 sep VARCHAR2(1 CHAR);
 download_bare_fname VARCHAR2(50);
 l_status VARCHAR2(1000);
BEGIN
 client_fsep := webutil_clientinfo.get_file_separator;
 sep := WebUtil_Core.getServerFileSep;
 download_bare_fname := substr(download_fname,instr(download_fname,sep,-1)+1); 
 client_fname := download_dir || client_fsep || download_bare_fname; 
 l_success := webutil_file_transfer.AS_to_Client_with_progress
 (clientFile => client_fname
 ,serverFile => download_fname
 ,progressTitle => 'Title'
 ,progressSubTitle => 'SubTitle'
 );
 if l_success
 then
 -- message('File downloaded successfully from the Application Server');
 return true;
 else
 --message('File download from Application Server failed');
 return false;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when others
 then
 l_status := 'File - ' || download_fname ||' - Download Failed: ' || substr(sqlerrm,75);
 log_error('LTAPI', 'MOBILE PC DOWNLOAD', l_status);
 return false;
END;

FUNCTION UPLOAD_AS(upload_filename IN VARCHAR2) RETURN BOOLEAN IS
 l_success BOOLEAN;
 upload_bare_filename VARCHAR2(50);
 m_workarea VARCHAR2(512);
 sep VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := WebUtil_Core.getServerFileSep;
 client_file_sep VARCHAR2(1 CHAR) := webutil_clientinfo.get_file_separator;
 server_filename VARCHAR2(512);
BEGIN
 m_workarea := WebUtil_Core.ReadFromPropertyBundle('transfer.appsrv.workAreaRoot');
 --l_bare_filename := substr(upload_filename,instr(upload_filename,'\',-1)+1);
 --server_filename := m_workarea || sep || WebUtil_Core.getClientUserName || sep || l_bare_filename; 
 upload_bare_filename := substr(upload_filename,instr(upload_filename,client_file_sep,-1)+1); 
 server_filename := m_workarea || sep || upload_bare_filename; 
 
 l_success := webutil_file_transfer.Client_To_AS_with_progress
 (clientFile => upload_filename -- 'C:\LTExtract\temp.txt';
 ,serverFile => server_filename --'/tmp/webutil/upload.dmp'--d:\temp\'||l_bare_filename
 ,progressTitle => 'Upload to Server in progress'
 ,progressSubTitle => 'Please wait'
 ,asynchronous => false
 ,callbackTrigger => null
 ); 
 if l_success
 then
 --message('File uploaded successfully to the Application Server');
 return true;
 else
 --message('File upload to Application Server failed');
 return false;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when others
 then
 message('File upload failed: '||sqlerrm);pause;
 return false;
 

END;

 exception

 then

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_LAPTOPID_FROM_FILENAME
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
FUNCTION get_LaptopID_from_FileName(fileName_in IN VARCHAR2) RETURN CHAR IS
 n_sepPos1 NUMBER;
 n_sepPos2 NUMBER;
 l_laptop_id VARCHAR2(100) := NULL;
BEGIN
 n_sepPos1 := instr(fileName_in,'_', -1, 2);
 n_sepPos2 := instr(fileName_in,'_', -1, 1);
 l_laptop_id := substr(fileName_in, (n_sepPos2 +1), (n_sepPos1 - n_sepPos2 - 1));
 RETURN l_laptop_id;
END;
